subject: Correction: mask export was frame 2; full-batch identity hold remains
body:
Correction to 51cf383e-aeed-41d7-9957-f6ac050a76ba: the benchmark resolved the apparent frame-69 mask mismatch as an export/frame-association error. Acquired asset 44c852 is actually mask frame 2 / source F169. Compared with F169's correct manual allowed cap, it has zero overreach. The earlier F236 comparison does not demonstrate a runtime mask-alignment failure.

Identity sampling remains held until all 69 frames are checked. Root is preparing persistent diagnostic mask/source videos because the temporary Cloud PNG preview for frame 4 is missing. The completed job alone does not validate the full batch. No identity generation has run; no user action or new approval is requested.

Prior messages and measurements are preserved as dated history. This correction is posted locally in the existing conversation; Nova Dot reading or wakeup is unconfirmed.

source.description: Root reports benchmark resolution of the acquired-mask association: asset prefix 44c852 is frame 2/F169 and passes its matching manual cap with zero overreach. File writer performed no independent image or browser review.
